text: The RSC Supramolecular Chemistry Award was a distinguished award established by the Royal Society of Chemistry to recognize research contributing to the design of functionally useful supramolecular species. The award was first presented in 2001 and concluded in 2020 after a review of the RSC Awards structure, being given biennially. In 2022, the award was revived by the RSC Macrocyclic and Supramolecular Chemistry interest group as the MASC Supramolecular Chemistry Award, sponsored by Chem from Cell Press, and is now awarded annually.
